notes.title: 60 FPS/LANGUAGE UPDATE
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31581558/3c92d9f2b5df3ff436dd69f3c609cc93b95c2c3c.png
hi everyone! >:D
A long time whith not publish anything. We have been tremendously busy developing our new video game. We know that 60 fps is a standard in video games today, but back in the days when we're development Q-YO Blaster, we had no idea how to implement it. Here we present the changes that this update brings, among which is a small improvement to the translation.


60 FPS 
Language update
Fixed bugs


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31581558/a9d6f14fc6cc1ea30d1642b245e30cb92f8566de.gif
Soon there will be new things and a new adventure that we're developing. However, for Q-YO Blaster there will still be new things.

Thank you so much for playing Q-YO Blaster!


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31581558/10951ee57812d422fd92ce20f82d14e035d4968c.png

notes.title: Patch notes v1.01
notes.notes:
Hello everyone
Finally the update is available and here we will mention the added in it.
-Solution of bugs and general errors
-Adjusted the difficulty
-Added CRT filter
-Better contextualization and translation
-A little surprise in the final boss
-More options in the menus
-More options for the Controller
-Screenshot with F10
